title: Norml Skill Creator
pitch: Build source-backed skills with clear audience, portable structure, truthful docs and verified discovery.
problem: A copied folder can retain private paths, dependencies and data. A polished guide can also promise behavior that the source never implemented.
This skill classifies ownership and sharing scope, preserves original sources, and verifies actual procedures before claiming readiness.

flow.d: Resolve audience, intent, source owner and adjacent skills.
Select shared, internal, client, product or public packaging.
Write grounded procedures, failures and acceptance checks.
Check links, boundaries, scripts and truthful human docs.
Execute these separate effects only when requested.

items: No mandatory company registry, cloud drive or host organization.
Package creation does not authorize remote creation, visibility change, runtime installation or website release.
Live transactions are not migration verification fixtures.

callout.label: Scope
callout.text: No mandatory company registry, cloud drive or host organization.
